summary: FD_TC_138_Not Eligible | EU 261 | All OAL Itinerary
title: Not Eligible | EU 261 | All OAL Itinerary
description:
All legs of the journey are operated by a non-EU carrier (e.g., Air Canada is Canadian, not EU-based). Flight ARRIVES in EU but does NOT depart from EU. Under EU 261, flights arriving in EU are only covered if operated by an EU-based carrier. Since AC is not EU-based, EU 261 does NOT apply for inbound flights. Validates that DDS correctly applies the EU carrier check for arriving flights.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger, 1 leg AC operated YYZ?LHR (Canada to UK). Itinerary: Scheduled arrival 08:00 (LHR local), Actual arrival 12:00 (4hr delay). Disruption code: 42 (Controllable). Carrier: AC (Canadian carrier � NOT an EU-based carrier). Route direction: Arriving in EU/UK, NOT departing from EU/UK.
